items.title: 3 Cell Tower REITs Positioned to Profit as Wireless Data Demand Quadruples
items.summary: One tower REIT slashed its dividend last year, another has raised its payout every year since 2019, and a third yields the most with the least cushion. Which one deserves your income dollars before the next spectrum auction?

items.title: Billboards and Cell Towers Collect Rent From Brands and Carriers, and $120,000 Across These 3 Stocks Pays $5,077 a Year
items.summary: A highway billboard and a ridge-top cell tower run on the same simple model: own the structure, collect the rent. Three REIT landlords turn that rent into dividends, but one has already slashed its payout, and the ad-driven names carry their own boom-and-bust risk.

items.title: Are Wall Street Analysts Bullish on Crown Castle Stock?
items.summary: Crown Castle has underperformed the broader market over the past year, but analysts are moderately optimistic about the stock’s prospects.

items.title: Crown Castle Soars 31% in a Month on SpaceX’s Tower Push: “We’re Talking to All Parties”
items.summary: Key TakeawaysCrown Castle (CCI) stock surged 31% from October 2 to November 2, closing at $87. 03 as SpaceX (SPCX) pursued wireless spectrum and potential tower leases.

items.title: Crown Castle Soars 6% as SpaceX Taps Qualcomm for a “Credible Fourth” Mobile Network
items.summary: Key TakeawaysCrown Castle stock rose 6% today after SpaceX picked Qualcomm to supply base stations for Starlink Mobile’s US 5G network, starting in 2027. Starlink Mobile will need towers, and a fourth carrier could fill the hole DISH left in Crown Castle’s leasing.

items.title: Wireless Data Demand Is Surging. Why Did Crown Castle Cut Its Dividend 32%?
items.summary: Americans are consuming wireless data at a record pace, yet one of the biggest tower landlords just slashed its dividend by nearly a third. Understanding which tower REITs can still grow their payouts requires a close look at what separates a safe yield from a trap.

items.title: SpaceX's $28 Billion Spectrum Deals May Not Be Enough: Expert Sees Another $130 Billion to Rival T-Mobile
items.summary: Elon Musk’s SpaceX (NASDAQ:SPCX) has agreed to nearly $28 billion in wireless spectrum deals. But telecommunications expert William Webb estimates it could need another $120 billion to $130 billion to compete with T-Mobile US Inc. (NASDAQ:TMUS) and America’s other major...

items.title: DLR Q3 FFO & Revenues Beat Estimates on Rental Growth, '26 View Raised
items.summary: Digital Realty's record bookings, rising occupancy and stronger rental rates drive double-digit core FFO growth as the company raises its 2026 outlook.
